title: Origin Realms Default Skins
description: Occasionally Changes Default Skins to have Overlays from Origin Realms.
body:
# Default skins are sorta boring.
**This Resourcepack changes default skins to have an overlay from the [Origin Realms](https://originrealms.com/) server when the skin is not loaded for better immersion.**

Some examples include,
- 📹 While using the [Flashback Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback) Editor
- 🛜 While Offline
- ⌚ If you're in a Queue for a Server
- ⚠️ When a server fails to send skins
- 🤔 And many more Niche Senarios

![Default skins during a skin error on the Diamondfire Server.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7ae01667745d75dd0450d19f338e828cb128c5b.png)

![Default skins during a ghost error on the Wynncraft Server.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57d680c0b32629fd809ea91bcba266ca695639e3.png)

**Assets used with permission from [Origin Realms](https://originrealms.com/)!**
